description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Wind Speed Standardization for Project Sentinel is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jennifer Bridge, University of Florida (ufl.edu). Wind speed measurements are resolved by a 3-axis gill anemometer array under chaotic vibrating conditions using time-resolved tiltmeter measurements. Project Sentinel targets the acquisition of in-situ wind speed measurements from directly coastal (i.e. beach) positions during hurricane landfall. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5qn4-gz26. Keywords: Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel, Surface Wind Measurements, Hurricane, FCMP, Measurements, Calibration. Published 2022-08-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
